{{Quote|Just as our families are defined by their function in society, so are we defined by our roles as representatives of those families. We are here before you not as people, but as the beginning and end points of a decision-making process.|Bronze, to [[Mara Jade Skywalker]]|<ref name="Refugee" />}}
A [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] simply known as "'''Bronze'''" was the representative of [[Chiss family/Legends|one]] of the ruling [[Ruling Families/Legends|Four Families]] of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]]. The Chiss wore a [[Color/Legends|bronze]] head-to-foot [[Chiss robes of state|robe]] and spoke in a rich [[:wikipedia:Contralto|contralto]] voice.<ref name="Refugee" />
